title: Point sequence encoding
statement: For a Boolean list $z$, define its point sequence encoding by applying the iteration `forLoop` with step `ptStep` to the nested pair encoding of $p_N(z)$, $p_I(z)$ with four `true` entries appended, and $p_R(z)$ paired with the empty list.
caveat: The meanings of `forLoop`, `ptStep`, `pairEncode`, and the component functions are not provided, so the construction can only be stated in terms of them.
